entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
By way of this petition, the petitioner has prayed for the following reliefs:
(A) Your Lordships be pleased to allow and admit the petition;

entities.text: Ramabhai Hebabhai vs Deputy Collector on 12 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (C)Your Lordships be pleased to direct the respondent authorities for referring application to the Land Reference court within stipulated time and also decide the reference application by the land reference court at the earliest within some time frame period.

2. It was pointed out by learned advocate Mr. Tejas Satta for the petitioner that though the petitioner has preferred an NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/17796/2023 ORDER DATED: 12/12/2023 undefined application being LAQ No. 16 of 1995 to the Deputy Collector, Land Acquisition and Rehabilitation (Irrigation), Jamnagar and though petitioner's application for land reference made as back as on 15.06.1999 was accepted, the aforesaid application has not been referred to the District Court under section 18 of the Land Reference and therefore, by way of this petition, the petitioner is seeking a direction for referring the application of the petitioner to the concerned District Court under section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act.
3.

Considering the fact that the petitioner's application is pending since 1999 before the Deputy Collector as stated by learned advocate Mr. Satta and also considering the fact that earlier vide communication, the Deputy Collector, Land Acquisition and Rehabilitation (Irrigation, Jamnagar)
had informed the learend advocate for the petitioner that application made by the petitioner on 15.06.1999 is an application whereby the petitioner had accepted the amount of compensation under the protest and the same is not an application for reference, the application of the petitioner could not be referred.

4. In view of that, if the petitioner makes any fresh application for land reference, the concerned Deputy Collector is directed to do the needful as per the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act at the earliest from the date of application.
NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/17796/2023 ORDER DATED: 12/12/2023 undefined 5.
With the aforesaid direction, the present petition is disposed of.
